defs.def: a personal opinion about sth; an attitude towards sth （个人的）看法，意见，见解；态度

ex.s: My Views on Filming Short Videos on Campus
ex.t: "生态设计"是约翰对自己工作的称呼。

ex.s: Its views on history are well-presented.
ex.t: 它对历史的观点呈现得很好。

ex.s: a commonly-held view
ex.t: 一个普遍持有的观点

ex.s: Who would most probably enter for Take a view?
ex.t: 谁最可能报名参加Take a view？

ex.s: To voice his views on modern art.
ex.t: 为了表达他对现代艺术的看法。

ex.s: That’s our view on housework.
ex.t: 这就是我们对做家务的看法。

ex.s: （3）What was the author's view on factual reading？
ex.t: （3）作者对事实性阅读的看法是什么？

ex.s: Join a guided bike tour and view some of the most popular monuments in Washington, D.C.
ex.t: 参加有导游的骑行游，观赏华盛顿特区一些最受欢迎的纪念碑。

ex.s: An opinion can be a general or individual view, belief or impression.
ex.t: 观点可以是一种普遍的或个人的看法、信念或印象。

ex.s: 46   Meanwhile, positive thinking can help to stop negative self-talks and start to form a positive view on an issue.
ex.t: 46   同时，积极思考能帮助停止消极的自我对话，并开始对事物形成积极的看法。

ex.s: In looking for the stories of discovery, I found the stories of these people and how their lives changed our view of the world.
ex.t: 在寻找发现的故事时，我找到了这些人的故事，以及他们的生活如何改变了我们的世界观。

defs.def: a way of understanding or thinking about sth （理解或思维的）方法，方式

ex.s: High levels of knowledge can make people too attached to traditional ways of viewing problems across fields the arts, sciences, and politics.
ex.t: 高知识水平可能让人们在艺术、科学和政治等各领域过于执着于传统的看问题方式。

ex.s: Each of these views has its value, but if the claim is that any one of these is the scientific method, then they all fail.
ex.t: 这些观点各有价值，但如果声称其中任何一个是唯一的科学方法，那么它们都不成立。

ex.s: You can view these practices as a toolbox meant to aid your efforts to build a minimalist lifestyle that words for your particular circumstances.
ex.t: 你可以把这些练习看作一个工具箱，用来帮助你打造适合自己特定情况的极简生活方式。

ex.s: From a 21st-century point of view, the printed book is certainly ancient, but it remains as interactive as any battery-powered e-reader.
ex.t: 从21世纪的角度看，印刷书固然古老，但它仍像任何电池供电的电子阅读器一样具有互动性。

ex.s: In my view, science is not simple, and neither is the natural world.
ex.t: 在我看来，科学并不简单，自然世界也不简单。

ex.s: The students took on diverse topics and turned in stories, 10 to 20 pages each, with characters that broadened my view and touched my heart.
ex.t: 学生们选择了各种不同的主题，交上来的故事每篇10到20页，其中的人物开阔了我的视野，也触动了我的心。

ex.s: Though he acknowledges that engineering works can fail because the person who thought them up or engineered them simply got things wrong, in this book Dr Petroski widens his view to consider the larger context in which such failures occur.
ex.t: 尽管他承认，工程作品之所以会失败，可能是因为构想或设计它们的人犯了简单的错误，但在本书中，彼得罗斯基博士拓宽了视野，去考量此类失败发生的更大背景。

ex.s: However, psychologists have demonstrated that when adults read news stories, they remember more of the content than if they listen to or view identical pieces.
ex.t: 然而，心理学家已经证明，当成年人阅读新闻故事时，比起聆听或观看相同的片段，他们对内容的记忆更多。

ex.s: Researchers use brain imaging technique to see which brain areas light up when we view paintings that we consider beautiful.
ex.t: 研究人员使用脑成像技术来观察当我们观看我们认为美丽的画作时，哪些大脑区域会被激活。

defs.def: what you can see from a particular place or position, especially beautiful countryside （从某处看到的）景色，风景；（尤指）乡间美景

ex.s: Participants were randomly divided into two groups: the “beauty” group was asked to actively consider and then rate the beauty of each object they viewed, while the control group just matched a line drawing of the object with the artwork itself.
ex.t: 参与者被随机分为两组：“美”组被要求主动思考并为所看到的每件物品的美打分，而对照组只是将物品的线描图与艺术品本身进行匹配。

ex.s: China's National Highway 318,                    over 5,000 kilometers from Shanghai to Zhangmu, Tibet, is known as the "heavenly road“ for its amazing views.
ex.t: 中国的318国道                    5000多公里从上海延伸至西藏樟木因其惊人的景色而被称为"天路"。

ex.s: Breathtaking views of the lowlands of Carlow can be enjoyed in the presence of welcoming guides from local walking clubs.
ex.t: 在当地徒步俱乐部热情向导的陪伴下，你可以欣赏卡洛低地令人惊叹的景色。

ex.s: Bring along your camera and enjoy the wonderful views along this well-surfaced forest path.
ex.t: 带上相机，沿着这条铺设平整的森林小径欣赏美景吧。

ex.s: You’ll have views from both sides of the train.
ex.t: 你可以看到火车两侧的风景。

ex.s: When I finally stepped out of the trees, the view was breathtaking.
ex.t: 当我终于走出树林时，景色令人叹为观止。

ex.s: I was focusing on taking photos of the beautiful view, but suddenly I felt that someone or something was watching me.
ex.t: 我正专注于拍摄美丽的风景，但突然我感觉有什么人或什么东西在看着我。

defs.def: a photograph or picture that shows an interesting place or scene 风景照；风景画
a special chance to see or admire sth （一次）观看；一睹；一览
to think about sb/sth in a particular way 把 … 视为；以 … 看待

ex.s: So they have a ＂God’s eye view＂ of activities in their own markets and beyond.
ex.t: 所以它们在自己市场及以外的活动中拥有"上帝视角"。

ex.s: Those viewing the quality of Abbot Hall’s temporary exhibitions may be forgiven for thinking they are in a city gallery.
ex.t: 参观阿博特大厅临时展览水准的人，若以为自己身处城市画廊，是可以被原谅的。

ex.s: Comparing yourself with someone who is outperforming you could result in feelings of envy if you focus on the things they have and you don’t, or it can be energizing and inspiring if you use these comparisons as a source of motivation, for example, “If they can achieve that, so can I.” Comparing yourself with someone who is doing worse than you could result in fear and worry if you think about how you could fall into similar circumstances, or it can draw out feelings of gratitude and appreciation if you use that comparison to broaden your views — for example, “Wow, things could be much worse; I’m doing great.”
ex.t: 把自己和表现优于你的人比较，如果你盯着他们有而你没有的东西，可能产生嫉妒；但如果你把这些比较当作动力来源，比如“他们能做到，我也能”，它就会令人振奋和鼓舞。把自己和不如你的人比较，如果你想到自己也可能陷入类似境地，可能产生恐惧和担忧；但如果你用这种比较拓宽视角，比如“哇，情况可能更糟，我已经很不错了”，它就会引发感恩和知足。

ex.s: This research overturns the popular view that all human speech sounds were present when human beings evolved around 300,000 years ago. ”The set of speech sounds we use has not necessarily remained stable since the appearance of human beings, but rather the huge variety of speech sounds that we find today is the product of a complex interplay of things like biological change and cultural evolution,“ said Steven Moran, a member of the research team.
ex.t: 这项研究推翻了“人类约30万年前进化时所有语音都已存在”的流行观点。“我们使用的语音集合自人类出现以来未必保持稳定，我们今天发现的极其多样的语音，是生物变化和文化演变等事物复杂相互作用的产物，”研究团队成员史蒂文·莫兰说。

ex.s: She said trees should not be viewed as the enemy.
ex.t: 她说，树木不应被视为敌人。

ex.s: Societies all over the world view the concept of an adult as self-supporting and self-directed, because it identifies a point in the life cycle.
ex.t: 全世界的社会的都把“成年人”这一概念视为能够自立和自主，因为它标示了生命周期中的一个节点。

ex.s: When something is contradictory to their view, they don’t treat it as exceptional.
ex.t: 当某事与他们的观点相矛盾时，他们不会将其视为例外。

ex.s: Generalists, on the other hand, know a lot about a wide range of subjects and view the whole with all its connections.
ex.t: 另一方面，通才对广泛的学科知之甚多，并能带着所有联系去看待整体。

defs.def: to look at sth, especially when you look carefully 看；观看；（尤指）仔细察看

ex.s: And are listening to and viewing content as effective as reading the written word when covering the same material?
ex.t: 在学习同样的材料时，听和看内容与阅读文字一样有效吗？

ex.s: Point of view Arguments Supporting examples ·In my opinion,...
ex.t: 观点 论证 支持性例子 ·依我看，……

defs.def: to visit a house, etc. with the intention of buying or renting it 查看，察看（房子等，以便购买或租用）
to watch television, a film/movie, etc. 看，观看（电视、电影等）

ex.s: The team’s data only went up to 2007, but the researchers also explored what would happen if consumers replaced old products with new electronics that serve more than one function, such as a tablet for word processing and TV viewing.
ex.t: 团队的数据只统计到2007年，但研究人员还探讨了如果消费者用具有多种功能的新电子产品替代旧产品会发生什么，例如用于文字处理和看电视的平板电脑。

ex.s: They found that more on-demand entertainment viewing on tablets instead of TVs and desktop computers could cut energy consumption by 44%.
ex.t: 他们发现，更多在平板电脑上而不是电视和台式电脑上进行按需娱乐观看可以将能耗降低44%。

ex.s: The Princess Diaries Viewer reviews What an interesting movie 2 March | by Jane The princess Diaries is a movie about a teenager named Mia Thermopolis.
ex.t: 《公主日记》 观众评论 多有趣的电影 3月2日 | by Jane 《公主日记》是一部关于一个名叫 Mia Thermopolis 的少女的电影。
